style.backgroundSystem: pure white #FFFFFF for packshots and spec screens, mist blue #D8EAF6 water-themed backgrounds for benefit and CTA shots, deep charcoal #1E2226 low-key backgrounds for motor macro and waterproof trust shots

style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean fresh personal-care electronics visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white #FFFFFF, mist blue #D8EAF6, deep charcoal #2B2F33 and one water-blue accent #6FA8DC; bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key, gentle cool rim light and soft contact shadows, low-key directional light only on dark macro and trust shots; modern geometric sans-serif headline type in charcoal #2B2F33 on light grounds and #FFFFFF on dark grounds; consistent rounded circular info bubbles and thin-line icons; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable upright product stance and consistent product scale; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable upright product stance, consistent product scale across the set, hero angle reused for variant grid, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout
style.surfaceSystem: matte light-stone counter #E7E2DC for scenes, seamless studio backdrops elsewhere, subtle water droplets on dark surfaces
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headline type in charcoal #2B2F33 on light grounds and #FFFFFF on dark grounds, with thin-line labels for feature annotations
